**Native forest tree-cover loss was detected in 2022, but deforestation is not established.**

Approximately 0.6 ha of tree-cover loss was mapped on the 17.6 ha property. Of that event area, 0.5 ha was mapped as native forest in the 2021 MGAP forest map; the remaining 0.1 ha was outside mapped forest. The entire event area was classified as forest in the JRC 2020 reference.

Tree-cover loss can result from causes other than deforestation or land-use change. The evidence does not establish the cause or whether the land was converted to another use.
